newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries up at noon, friendly sales data seen.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries up at noon, friendly sales data seen.

text.p: *Bonds firmer. Fund demand for three-year notes seen, with some some 10-yr offered against. Cash flow seen supportive before Thurs Treasury coupon payment. Cheap dollar aids market. *Steeper curve still seen, Greenspan dents May 20 hike odds. *Apr retail sales Tues seen weak, longs carefully built ahead.
